name: walmart/product-reviews
description: Get Walmart product reviews by product ID: overall rating, ratings histogram, top positive and negative reviews, and paginated review text with photos.

page.description: Value is used to get the reviews on a specific page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.).

sort.description: Sorting reviews. It can be set to: `relevancy`, `helpful`, `submission-desc`, `submission-asc`, `rating-desc`, `rating-asc`

rating.description: Filtering reviews by rating. It can be set to: `1`: 1-star, `2`: 2-star, `3`: 3-star, `4`: 4-star, `5`: 5-star.

product_id.description: The unique product identifier to get reviews of a specific product. You need to pass the `us_item_id`. It can be found from either Organic Results API or Product API results.

json_restrictor.description: The fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.
